about: Running Draw (katana.k_sl, the sprint light), milestone-1 task 75: Attack1H01_R's one-handed cut from the right, swept across at the hips into a point straight ahead, out of a sprint: the wind-up drawn back low at the right hip over the run's strides (source frames 0-4.5 over 11), the sweep at its own speed into the active frames (13.5-15.5), the point held as the run's momentum carries the body over the front foot, then back to the guard by the settle at 33. One-handed, as the owner chose for the lights (Oct 8); the blade starts and ends 45 degrees lower, as the one-handed guard carries it. Four running strides carry the body 2.2 m forward, the left foot planting into the lunge at the cut, the back foot dragged up after. Source frames at 30 fps from 0.
